d: India's coveted Big Tech dream is facing fresh uncertainty. Google and Microsoft are reportedly considering putting their 2027 campus hiring plans in India on hold, raising concerns for thousands of aspiring engineers. Meanwhile, employee allegations of job cuts at Google have added to fears, although the company has denied reports of wider layoffs. A Blind survey reveals that 72% of surveyed Indian professionals would consider switching careers. With AI, automation, mounting workplace pressure and over 200,000 reported tech job losses, is India's IT golden era losing its shine? Firstpost…
